segments.text:
​​​ ​You had the perfect opportunity​ ​​
​​ ​to frag that noob.​ ​​
​​​ ​Why did you miss the snipe?​ ​​
​​​ ​Now that f00 is running away from the flak.​ ​​
​​​ ​Could it be…?​ ​​
​​​ ​Did you take pity because you like her?​ ​​
​​​ ​Don't even try to tell me it was an accident.​ ​​
​​​ ​I've seen your mad skillz before, my guy.​ ​​
​​​ ​Watched you 360 no scope three doodz​ ​​
​​​ ​with one shot,​ ​​
​​​ ​like you were in god mode.​ ​​
​​​ ​It's not as if you're usually nice either.​ ​​
​​​ ​You'll spawn camp all day,​ ​​
​​​ ​every day if it helps secure you that win.​ ​​

​​​ ​So, what is it that's drawing you​ ​​
​​ ​to that filthy casual?​ ​​
​​​ ​Is it her voice?​ ​​
​​​ ​Her cute laugh?​ ​​
​​​ ​No, I'm ​not tilted.​ ​​

​​​ ​I just don't understand what draws​ ​​
​​ ​an uber GOAT like you​ ​​

​​​ ​to a spray-and-pray low-level​ ​​
​​ ​using the starter skin​ ​​

​​​ ​like she has no sense of​ ​​
​​ ​pride and accomplishment.​ ​​
​​​ ​So, I'm confused, is all.​ ​​
​​​ ​It just seems wrong.​ ​​
​​​ ​Like a DPS running in before the tank.​ ​​

​​​ ​Which is exactly what a scrub like her​ ​​
​​ ​probably does all the time!​ ​​

​​​ ​You shouldn't be pulled in​ ​​
​​ ​by someone like her.​ ​​
​​​ ​Cozying up to those kinds of people ​ ​​
​​​ ​just drags down your ranking.​ ​​
​​​ ​You don't wanna drop a tier, do you?​ ​​

​​​ ​Before you know it, you'll be in a clan​ ​​
​​ ​with lagging, non-meta suxors​ ​​

​​​ ​who wouldn't know phat loot if it stood up​ ​​
​​ ​and introduced itself to her.​ ​​
​​​ ​I just don't wanna see you QQ.​ ​​

​​​ ​You should stay away from that girl​ ​​
​​ ​while you still have the chance.​ ​​
​​​ ​You agree with me, right?​ ​​
​​​ ​After all that gear farming we've done together,​ ​​
​​​ ​you're not gonna leave me, right?​ ​​
​​​ ​Then the next time you see her,​ ​​
​​​ ​we'll pwn her so hard​ ​​
​​​ ​that she'll never want to respawn.​ ​​
